topic: The Fourier Transform: Decoding the Universe's Ingredients
target_audience: Undergraduate science and engineering students, or enthusiasts with a basic grasp of calculus.

sections.title: The Big Idea: The Smoothie Metaphor
lecture_lines: Imagine a complex smoothie with many mixed flavors.
The Fourier Transform acts like a mathematical prism.
It separates the smoothie into individual ingredients.
animations: Show a complex wave (sum of three sine waves) in Purple (#A020F0).
Animate a White prism icon (#FFFFFF) appearing in the center of the screen.

Transform the complex wave through the prism into three vertically stacked sine waves: Red (#FF0000), Yellow (#FFFF00), and Blue (#0000FF) with text labels '3 Strawberries', '1 Banana', and '10 Blueberries'.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Pure Sine Wave
lecture_lines: Every complex signal is built from simple sine waves.
Amplitude represents the strength or volume of the wave.
Frequency determines the pitch or speed of oscillation.
animations: Draw a sine wave with large amplitude and low frequency in Green (#00FF00) labeled 'Elephant' [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/elephant.svg].
Draw a sine wave with small amplitude and high frequency in Pink (#FFC0CB) labeled 'Hummingbird' [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/humming.svg].
Animate arrows highlighting the 'Amplitude' (height) and 'Frequency' (peak spacing) on the waves.

sections.title: A Change of Perspective: Time vs. Frequency
lecture_lines: We usually see signals as amplitude over time.
This is known as the Time Domain view.
But we can shift to the Frequency Domain.
Waves become clean bars at specific frequencies.
The Fourier Transform bridges these two worlds.
animations: Show a complex wave in Cyan (#00FFFF) on a horizontal Time axis.
Display the text 'Time Domain' in White (#FFFFFF) above the wave.
Fade the Time axis and the wave, then draw a Frequency axis in its place.
Draw three vertical bars in Red (#FF0000), Green (#00FF00), and Blue (#0000FF) at different positions on the Frequency axis.
Display a glowing white bridge icon (#FFFFFF) at the top of the screen connecting the labels 'Time' and 'Frequency'.

sections.title: The Mechanism: The 'Wrapping' Visualization
lecture_lines: Imagine wrapping a signal around a spinning circle.
We change the wrapping frequency and track the shape.
Most frequencies result in a centered, messy blob.
At the right frequency, the shape shifts off-center.
This shift creates a peak in our frequency chart.
animations: Show a Yellow (#FFFF00) sine wave wrapping into a circle around a central origin.
Animate the winding speed of the signal around the circle increasing over time.
Display the shape as a balanced, centered circular blob in White (#FFFFFF) representing a non-matching frequency.
Morph the centered blob into an unbalanced shape that is visibly shifted to one side.
Place a Red dot (#FF0000) at the center of mass of the shifted shape and show a vertical frequency peak rising.

sections.title: Practical Application: Noise Cancellation
lecture_lines: Real-world signals often contain unwanted noise or hums.
In the Frequency Domain, noise stands out clearly.
We can simply delete these unwanted frequency bars.
Applying an inverse transform recreates the clean signal.
Now, the original signal is clear and noise-free.
animations: Display a Light Blue (#ADD8E6) noisy wave with high-frequency jitter.
Transition to a frequency spectrum with a tall Green bar (#00FF00) and a short Grey bar (#808080) for noise.
Draw a Red 'X' (#FF0000) over the Grey bar and fade it out.
Transition back to the time domain, showing the noisy wave beginning to smooth out.
Display a smooth, clean sine wave in bright Green (#00FF00).

sections.title: Summary: The Universal Decoder
lecture_lines: From smoothies to signals, everything has hidden ingredients.
The Fourier Transform decodes the universe's complex patterns.
It powers modern technology from WiFi to medical imaging.
animations: Draw two circles labeled 'Time' and 'Frequency' on opposite sides of the screen.
Animate a glowing white bridge (#FFFFFF) connecting the two domains.
Animate icons for Wi-Fi, JPEG, and MRI moving across the bridge.
